final: WITH g AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.circuitId, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS prop FROM g CROSS JOIN t), a AS (SELECT AVG(prop) AS avgprop FROM p) SELECT p.circuitId, p.cnt, p.prop, p.prop - a.avgprop AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN a WHERE p.prop > a.avgprop ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
